member.name: T:DrugExpansion.Content.IDrugContentModule
member.summary: One independently registered custom drug kind and its products.
member.remarks: A module owns its durable IDs, persistence, visuals, packaging, production, and optional mixing strategy. The catalog does not derive capabilities from a vanilla drug enum, so a future entirely custom kind can opt into mixing on its own terms.

member.name: T:DrugExpansion.Content.Mdma.Production.ManualTabletPressAsset
member.summary: Loads the tablet-press visual and exposes its native-aligned mechanical anchors. Station behavior remains authoritative; the GLB animation is reference motion only.

member.name: T:DrugExpansion.Content.Mdma.Production.ManualTabletPressRig
member.summary: Named visual assemblies and interaction anchors required by the tablet station. Names deliberately parallel the native Brick Press contract without copying its product conversion behavior.

member.name: T:DrugExpansion.Content.Mdma.Production.ManualTabletPressRuntime
member.summary: Adapts the native Brick Press lifecycle for the DrugExpansion tablet press. Inventory and slot replication remain native and authoritative; the authored model and ejected rigidbodies are local presentation.

member.name: T:DrugExpansion.Content.IMixingCapability
member.summary: Optional capability implemented by a drug module that participates in mixing.
member.remarks: Logical product identity and mixability are intentionally independent. Implementations may use a native execution strategy internally, but must not require the custom kind to masquerade as a built-in Schedule I product family.
